body:

register_notes: Stage 3 EN comparison_aggregator: references prior email + earlier stages so the cascade reads as one thread; direct close with easy out (releases the prospect if timing is wrong); no MobUpps figure; 0 question marks; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' (positive specs); native English.
